messages.content: Every minute, read /mnt/demo/release-checklist.md and save status.md listing the unchecked items and their owners. Goal for each run: status.md lists every unchecked item. When every item is checked, write a final summary and stop this schedule. Max 5 runs. Timezone Asia/Shanghai.
